title: The Lost One's Camp
text: A cold camp under an overhang: a bedroll, a fire long out, a single bowl licked clean. A journal lies open on the stones, the pages warped with damp, the writing in a Scion's hand. The last entry stops halfway through a word.

outcomes.text: Their last days, and where they went, and what they heard at night.

options.label: The best tracker follows them from here.

outcomes.text: Fresh enough. They might still be alive.
The fire takes, and the night is quiet, and nothing comes. Nothing came for them either, at first.
